paragraphs.text: 1. TASTE this strong draught enriched with offered viands: with all thy chariot here unyoke thy Coursers.
paragraphs.original: तीव्रस्याभिवयसो अस्य पाहि सर्वरथा वि हरी इह मुञ्च ।
paragraphs.translit: tīvrasyābhivayaso asya pāhi sarvarathā vi harī iha muñca |

paragraphs.text: Let not those other sacrificers stay thee, Indra: these juices shed for thee are ready.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्र मा त्वा यजमानासो अन्ये नि रीरमन्तुभ्यमिमे सुतासः
paragraphs.translit: indra mā tvā yajamānāso anye ni rīramantubhyamime sutāsaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Thine is the juice effused, thine are the juices yet to be pressed: our resonant songs invite thee.
paragraphs.original: तुभ्यं सुतास्तुभ्यमु सोत्वासस्त्वां गिरः श्वात्र्या आ ह्वयन्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: tubhyaṃ sutāstubhyamu sotvāsastvāṃ giraḥ śvātryā ā hvayanti |

paragraphs.text: O Indra, pleased to-day with this libation, come, thou who knowest all and drink the Soma.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रेदमद्य सवनं जुषाणो विश्वस्य विद्वाँ इह पाहि सोमम्
paragraphs.translit: indredamadya savanaṃ juṣāṇo viśvasya vidvām̐ iha pāhi somam

paragraphs.text: 3. Whoso, devoted to the God, effuses Soma for him with yearning heart and spirit,-
paragraphs.original: य उशता मनसा सोममस्मै सर्वहृदा देवकामः सुनोति ।
paragraphs.translit: ya uśatā manasā somamasmai sarvahṛdā devakāmaḥ sunoti |

paragraphs.text: Never doth Indra give away his cattle: for him he makes the lovely Soma famous.
paragraphs.original: न गा इन्द्रस्तस्य परा ददाति प्रशस्तमिच्चारुमस्मै कृणोति
paragraphs.translit: na gā indrastasya parā dadāti praśastamiccārumasmai kṛṇoti

paragraphs.text: 4. He looks with loving favour on the mortal who, like a rich man, pours for him the Soma.
paragraphs.original: अनुस्पष्टो भवत्येषो अस्य यो अस्मै रेवान्न सुनोति सोमम् ।
paragraphs.translit: anuspaṣṭo bhavatyeṣo asya yo asmai revānna sunoti somam |

paragraphs.text: Maghavan in his bended arm supports him: he slays, unasked, the men who hate devotion.
paragraphs.original: निररत्नौ मघवा तं दधाति ब्रह्मद्विषो हन्त्यनानुदिष्टः
paragraphs.translit: niraratnau maghavā taṃ dadhāti brahmadviṣo hantyanānudiṣṭaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. We call on thee to come to us, desirous of goods and spoil, of cattle, and of horses.
paragraphs.original: अश्वायन्तो गव्यन्तो वाजयन्तो हवामहे त्वोपगन्तवा उ ।
paragraphs.translit: aśvāyanto gavyanto vājayanto havāmahe tvopagantavā u |

paragraphs.text: For thy new love and favour are we present: let us invoke thee, Indra, as our welfare.
paragraphs.original: आभूषन्तस्ते सुमतौ नवायां वयमिन्द्र त्वा शुनं हुवेम
paragraphs.translit: ābhūṣantaste sumatau navāyāṃ vayamindra tvā śunaṃ huvema
